title: Mouse Whole Cell Tissue Processing for 10x Genomics Platform
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: Compresstome (Precisionary Instruments VF-300) with attached camera
Applies To: | Slice Preps with BFIs

steps.title: Enter Initial Specimen Information
steps.instruction: Input the required specimen and timing data into the system prior to slicing.

substeps.instruction: Enter username and ID number for the specimen being sliced.
Enter the date sliced and ACSF dates (where applicable).

steps.title: Record Post-Slicing Timestamps
steps.instruction: Enter the sacrifice and dissection completion times in the BFI program after slicing and mounting the tissue.

steps.title: Access Live Camera View
steps.instruction: Navigate to the live camera view by pressing the arrow button to the right of the screen.

steps.title: Capture Specimen Images
steps.instruction: Capture images of the specimen and manage the gallery as needed.

substeps.instruction: Press F1, the space bar, or the camera button to the right of the screen to take a picture.
Review captured images appearing on the bottom portion of the screen.
Delete unwanted photos by hovering over the icon and pressing the red X, then confirming the deletion.

steps.title: Record Completion Times
steps.instruction: Once all images are captured, press the arrow button on the right side of the screen to enter the slicing complete and incubation complete times.

steps.title: Save Slicing Data
steps.instruction: Save the session data to ensure it is exported to a CSV file.

substeps.instruction: Return to the live image screen.
Press the save button on the right side of the screen.
